Canvas landscape 3:2, arranged as EXACTLY 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, SIX square cells without drawn lines or borders. One waist-up seated version of this SAME character per cell, equal scale, centered in each cell, full head and both elbows contained with clear padding. Fixed camera, constant torso and pelvis placement across cells. Read left to right then next row: (0) tense ready pose, one hand holding a revolver at his own temple in a fictional casino roulette game; (1) survives an empty chamber, beginning to lower his gun hand to shoulder level, breathing out; (2) fully lowered gun at lap level, visibly relieved; (3) abrupt recoil reaction, head and shoulders slightly backward, gun hand beginning to fall; (4) torso leaning backward with startled expression, hand dropping; (5) slumped backward in chair, eyes closed, gun lowered. Non-graphic fictional game violence: NO blood, wound, visible injury, projectile, muzzle flash or smoke; those effects will be rendered in code. No table, no full chair, no room, no labels, numbers, words, UI or watermark. Don't alter identity between frames. The sheet will be sampled as a strict 3x2 grid, so regular identical cell size and exact character alignment are essential.
